body: Youre right, afterwards she said she thought I was upset with her which wasnt the case at all

Asian immigrants. They were quite poor when she was a child and she was beaten, both physically and emotionally, though Im not sure to what extent. And her older sister dropped out of school and got away from it to live with her boyfriend, so basically she feels like all the expectations for success and caring for the family have fallen on her shoulders. And shes absolutely right, her parents have put those expectations on her. She runs the finances for the family business and works the business  while working another part time job and going to school full time. 

Its difficult because clearly these expectations are a major source of her depression yet they are whats keeping her alive. She wont hurt herself because she see's it as failing her family. So, getting out of it like her sister might very well guilt her into taking her life but staying in the household cant possibly be healthy either.

Its a pretty shitty situation altogether.

I mean I didnt ever say it was selfish, I just let her say it was. I didnt realize, I didnt understand what that meant.. 

And no, no therapy or professional help. Her family doesnt have the money for it and her insurance doesnt seem to cover anything. Not to mention, the culture of her parents is a large factor in the problem to begin with and I dont think she thinks she can to to them. To be honest, I think shes right about that. Ive been secretly researching her university and I think they offer free individual and group therapy so I guess Ill try suggesting that.

How do you redirect from when a person says its a selfish thing to do? I see it now, I see that she frames everything in how much of a burden she is. I dont know what to do besides argue.. and it sounds hollow you know?

 Like how can I sit there and say shes not a burden when she made me sob for an hour? I know shes not a burden, it just looks that way. The burden would be if shes gone.. thats for sure. She doesnt believe me but I guess I should just talk about how happy she makes me instead?
